digest.component_or_area: jira DC mutations, parent field clearing via Epic Link
propositions: test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips was failing because it attempted to clear fields.parent on a sub-task, which Data Center rejects with HTTP 400; the operation succeeds when re-homed to clear the Epic Link on a standard-issue child instead.

The Epic Link clear must be primed through a local rebar edit so that should_propagate_removal recognizes the ref as MANAGED and fires; creating the issue under a parent Jira-side leaves the ref unmanaged and suppresses propagation.

Whether {epic_link_field_id: None} actually clears on DC 8.17.1 was the blocking unknown; two green cells from live run 30951453979 already answered it—set_parent(child, None) followed by raw-REST read asserts the Epic Link does clear.

The re-homed cell passes green on live run 30964805133 with 10 assertions (up from 7), no weakened round-trip, no skips, proving the Epic Link clear round-trips through a reconcile pass with a locally-primed parent.

The non-sub-task branch of set_parent lacks read-back verification unlike the sub-task branch; an Epic Link clear that silently no-ops would be invisible today, though the harness proves it does not currently no-op.
